items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All four acceptance criteria met; rule object, lint/mechanism split, loader, vocabulary copy with drift test, empty lists for two profiles, shadow warning, docs. supabase-nextjs deliberately stays legacy until U3a.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: load_rules never raises; a bad rule is dropped and named; wrong top-level type, corrupt bundled file and escaping paths are reported, not raised.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Paths must be relative with no .., drive or backslash; check_paths resolves realpath and requires containment; rule text goes through the control-character filter on stderr.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 57 new tests: every class/combination, mixed lists, recovery, path escape, CLI exit and JSON, shadow warning order, drift test, bundled pins.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Shape check is linear in the rule count; one extra JSON read only when a custom profile shadows a bundled one.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New module beside profile_model, under 300 lines; the resolver got shorter (296 to 288).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: a hand-written profile JSON (BOM, CRLF, non-ASCII probed through the real CLI); consumer: load_rules via validate. The probe found a doubled prefix in two messages, fixed and re-run.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: tmp_path only, no sleeps, no shared state; the symlink test skips where symlinks are unavailable.
